A commodity loader is being distributed to finance teams in the region through spoofed invoice mail. Stage-one payload is delivered as a base64 blob inside the macro; the decoded first stage begins with the marker string below. Defenders should add the encoded form to content inspection rules as published, without modification, since the actor rotates padding.
